Salman Khan, Sister Alvira Receive Chandigarh Court Notice in Fraud Case

Actor Salman Khan and his sister Alvira Khan Agnihotri have received a notice from a Chandigarh court. The notice is related to allegations of fraud. The court has ordered them to appear on October 5. The case reportedly stems from a dispute connected to the 'Being Human' brand and a promise allegedly made on the set of 'Bigg Boss'.
